description: This file contains the class HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_Validator, which performs validation on HTMLPurifier configuration schema objects such as interchange, namespace, id, and directive objects. It includes methods for validating structure, types, and consistency of configuration directives and their aliases within the HTMLPurifier library.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_Validator
classes.description: A class responsible for validating HTMLPurifier configuration schema objects such as interchange, namespace, id, and directive objects, ensuring their integrity and correctness.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a fully-formed interchange object, throwing an exception if invalid.

methods.name: validateNamespace
methods.description: Validates a namespace object within the interchange schema.

methods.name: validateId
methods.description: Validates an id object within the interchange schema.

methods.name: validateDirective
methods.description: Validates a directive object within the interchange schema.

methods.name: validateDirectiveAllowed
methods.description: Validates the 'allowed' values of a directive.

methods.name: with
methods.description: Creates a ValidatorAtom for validating simple member variables.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Emits an error with contextual information.

methods.name: getFormattedContext
methods.description: Returns a formatted string representing the current validation context.
